definition.activation_day: group rank <= 3 AND group average daily return >= 2% AND up ratio >= 60%
definition.leader_hit: stock is strict top 3, OR is >=5% on the activation day and within 0.30 percentage points of the strict #3 return; this avoids treating near-tied strong stocks as non-leaders
definition.top3_hit: stock appears in that group's strict top 3 daily returns on an activation day
definition.near_leader_hit: stock is outside strict top 3 but >=5% and within 0.30 percentage points of the strict #3 return
definition.top1_hit: stock ranks #1 by daily return inside the group on an activation day
definition.note: close-to-close daily data only; this does not measure intraday first mover timing
definition.follow_through: after a stock is in the expanded leader cohort on an activation day, measure close-to-close return 1/3/5 market trading days later; missing future prices are excluded
definition.group_follow_through: for each activation event, average constituent close-to-close returns from activation-day close to 1/3/5 market trading days later; then average those event returns and report positive-event win rate
definition.leader_position_score: on each activation day rank all priced members by daily pct; first place scores 100 and last place scores 0, linearly scaled in between; report the stock's average score across activation days
